caption: The free CRM puts upgrade locks on Data Hub, Prospecting Agent and Workflows, and keeps Upgrade to Starter in the menu. The hub name is hidden.
Importing our 3 test contacts: HubSpot matched First Name, Last Name and Email by itself. The addresses are example.com test data.
A new form on the free plan carries the line Create your own free forms with the HubSpot logo. We saved it and did not publish it.
The public plans page in euros, billed monthly: Free at 0, Starter at 10 euro per seat (50% off), Professional at 100 and Enterprise at 175 euro per seat a month.
Account and Billing shows Free for up to 2 users, next to an offer of Starter at $7 a seat a month, save up to 65%. Hub name and hub ID are hidden.
Our $500 test deal took 3 steps, in the pipeline the setup wizard built. Next to it sits a $1,000 HubSpot sample deal. Deal owner, hub name and sample contact are hidden.
